# Synthetic isolated format fixtures

No user files. One-page PDF with xref, 1×1 RGB PNG (zlib + PNG CRC), mono PCM WAV
(8 kHz, 0.1 s), and MP4 H.264 red frames generated by ffmpeg from lavfi color.
These are complete small files, not extension-only headers. Transfer tests verify
identical bytes and SHA-256 at durable fixture storage. They do not prove ThreadDesk
viewing/indexing or all variants of these formats. Office/ZIP container cases are
separate transport/archive-validation tests. Payload.bin exercises multi-chunk bytes.
